name: Kasun Wickramaratne
summary: Backend developer with 4 years of professional experience building web applications and REST APIs in PHP and Laravel. Owns features end to end: MySQL database design, Laravel services and queues, API contracts for web and mobile clients, automated tests and deployment to AWS. Working knowledge of Vue.js. Looking for a mid-level backend role in Colombo (on-site or hybrid) or a remote role open to candidates in Sri Lanka.

experience.description: Builds and maintains Laravel 10/11 REST APIs for a property-management SaaS used by about 300 apartment complexes, consumed by a Vue.js web app and Flutter mobile apps. Redesigned invoicing tables and indexes (billing run from 40 to under 6 minutes), moved slow work to Redis queues with Horizon (about 35% lower p95), wrote Pest feature tests (billing coverage 20% to 70%), supports AWS releases (EC2, Nginx, RDS, S3) and mentors two interns.

Developed Laravel and plain-PHP applications for 8+ client projects including an online store and a student-management portal. Integrated local payment and SMS gateways via REST APIs and webhooks, built Blade/jQuery/Vue admin dashboards, and wrote MySQL reports and migrations.
Fixed bugs and added small features in PHP/Laravel projects; wrote API documentation in Postman.
